svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-07-20
svg.desc: Role reload tooling and combat interface data.
svg.text: 2026-07-20 - Role reload and combat interface data
main | 2 commits: 25064a7, d0d1f6d
Daily job
Make role iteration faster and expose a cross-character combat fact.
Editor reload, runtime sentinel, RoleConfig reread, CombatInterface, animation use, and BungeeMan setup changed.
BEFORE
Slow data iteration
RoleConfig changes needed a broader restart.
Airborne state was not exposed generically.
BungeeMan role setup was incomplete.
Editor and runtime had no reload handshake.
AFTER
Reloadable role data and shared combat fact
Editor adds Reload Role Config and writes a runtime sentinel.
Game observes the sentinel and rereads RoleConfig.json.
CombatInterface exposes IsInAir to animation and character-base consumers.
BungeeMan equips/configures the Aura staff role path.
Guard: reload request is data iteration; IsInAir is cross-character interface state.
Important guard
Do not make each role consumer invent its
own reload or airborne-state query.
Keep both contracts centralized.
Validation / newcomer path
Use editor reload for RoleConfig iteration.
Use CombatInterface for IsInAir rather than
casting every character type.
